summary: FDM-printable compact Mini-ITX enclosure with motherboard/cooler, a conventional rear-panel dual-slot GPU bracket position, and a 160 x 80 x 40 mm 1U PSU.

required_interfaces.description: Visually and structurally verify the fully rebuilt top, Mini-ITX, PSU, conventional rear dual-slot GPU bracket and magnet screw-hole patterns declared by the current CAD brief.
Fit and retain a standard 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX motherboard with accessible rear I/O.
Fit the Thermalright AXP120-X67 envelope and preserve side-panel intake clearance.

Provide only a conventional two-slot GPU bracket position in the rear panel: two 18 x 120 mm expansion-slot apertures at 20.32 mm pitch and one M3 bracket retention point per slot. No printed GPU shelf, tail support, rear subframe, side receiver, side clamp, PCIe riser assembly or riser mounting hardware is included.
Rear-mount the user-specified 160 x 80 x 40 mm compact 1U PSU behind the motherboard tray with AC inlet access, airflow, retention, and cable routing.
Provide one externally accessible power button with an internal path to the motherboard header.

assembly_story.installation: Place each foot directly under its corner-column axis, then fasten each independent column from below with one kit-selected M3 socket-cap screw passing through the foot and 3 mm base into the column; install the sixteen 10 x 10 x 3 mm countersunk magnets directly into the column pockets with centered M3 screws, mount the motherboard, secure the dual-slot GPU bracket only at the conventional rear-panel slot position, then install the selected PSU and route cables before fitting the four magnetically retained perimeter panels.
assembly_story.maintenance: Pull off the magnetically retained front, rear, left, or right service panel without tools; locating lips carry panel shear while magnets provide normal retention.

documents.description: Complete printable Mini-ITX enclosure assembly with four independently printable, underside-screwed corner columns
